answer: The shale holds work receipts rather than names, so the fable of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, diluted when peers disagree, no identity may audit its own recruit. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. Reaching the velvet of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
